scenes.line1: Why does your Django app feel slow?
scenes.line2: What is the N plus 1 problem?
scenes.say: Ever wonder why your Django app sometimes crawls? Let's talk about the N plus 1 query problem.

scenes.label: N+1
scenes.sub: One query for posts, then one more for each author.
scenes.say: The N plus 1 problem means your code makes one query for posts, then a separate query for each related author. That adds up fast.
To fix it, use select related to fetch posts and their authors in a single query.
Use select related for foreign keys or one-to-one fields. Use prefetch related for many-to-many or reverse relationships.

scenes.question: What does select_related fetch?
scenes.right: It only works for foreign key and one-to-one fields. Use prefetch related for many-to-many.
scenes.say: Don't mix them up. Select related is only for foreign key or one-to-one fields. For many-to-many, you need prefetch related.
